00069 void TableOscUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00070 {   
00071     float tableSizeOverSampleRate = UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate() * wavetableSize;
00072     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00073     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00074     float* freqSamples = inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00075     LOCAL_DECLARE(float, currentPhase);
00076     LOCAL_DECLARE(float, wavetableSize);
00077     
00078     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00079     {
00080         *outputSamples++ = lookupIndex(currentPhase);
00081         currentPhase += *freqSamples++ * tableSizeOverSampleRate;
00082         
00083         if(currentPhase >= wavetableSize)   currentPhase -= wavetableSize;
00084         else if(currentPhase < 0.f)         currentPhase += wavetableSize;
00085     }
00086     
00087     LOCAL_COPY(currentPhase);
00088 }

00158                                              const float initialPhase,

00160 :   TableOscUGenInternal(freq, initialPhase, table),
00161     value(0.f)

00165 
00166 void TableOscUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00167 {   
00168     const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();
00169     unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;
00170     double krBlockSizeOverSampleRate = UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate() * krBlockSize;
00171     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00172     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00173     float* freqSamples = inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00174     
00175     int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;
00176     
00177     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00178     {
00179         float nextValue = value;
00180         
00181         if(numKrSamples == 0)           
00182         {
00183             nextValue = lookupIndex(currentPhase);
00184             
00185             currentPhase += *freqSamples * krBlockSizeOverSampleRate * wavetableSize;
00186             
00187             while(currentPhase >= wavetableSize)    currentPhase -= wavetableSize;
00188             while(currentPhase < 0.f)               currentPhase += wavetableSize;
00189         }
00190         
00191         numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00192         
00193         blockPosition       += numKrSamples;
00194         freqSamples         += numKrSamples;
00195         
00196         if(nextValue == value)
00197         {
00198             while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00199             {
00200                 *outputSamples++ = nextValue;
00201                 --numSamplesToProcess;
00202                 --numKrSamples;
00203             }
00204         }
00205         else
00206         {
00207             float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) * UGen::getControlSlopeFactor();
00208             
00209             while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00210             {
00211                 *outputSamples++ = value;
00212                 value += valueSlope;
00213                 --numSamplesToProcess;
00214                 --numKrSamples;
00215             }
00216             
00217             value = nextValue;
00218         }
00219     }
00220 }

00223 TableOsc::TableOsc(Buffer const& table, UGen const& freq, Buffer const& initialPhase) throw()
00224 {   
00225     // could check here that the table is padded appropriately and use a less efficient version if not
00226     
00227     int numChannels = ugen::max(freq.getNumChannels(), initialPhase.size());
00228     
00229     initInternal(numChannels);
00230     
00231     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00232     {
00233         internalUGens[i] = new TableOscUGenInternal(freq, initialPhase.wrapAt(i), table);
00234     }
00235 }

00237 HarmonicOsc::HarmonicOsc(Buffer const& harmonicWeights, UGen const& freq, Buffer const& initialPhase) throw()
00238 {   
00239     int numChannels = ugen::max(freq.getNumChannels(), initialPhase.size());
00240     
00241     initInternal(numChannels);
00242     
00243     Buffer table(BufferSpec(8193, 1, true));
00244     
00245     for(int harmonic = 1; harmonic <= harmonicWeights.size(); harmonic++)
00246     {
00247         float amp = harmonicWeights.getSampleUnchecked(0, harmonic-1);
00248         table += Buffer::line(8193, 0.0, harmonic * twopi).sin() * amp;
00249     }
00250     
00251     table = table.shrinkSize();
00252     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00253     {
00254         internalUGens[i] = new TableOscUGenInternal(freq, initialPhase.wrapAt(i), table);
00255     }
00256 }
